facts.claim: MSC Musica (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2006; 92,409 GT; 2550 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Musica class.
MSC Musica is the first Musica-class cruise ship built in 2006 and operated by MSC Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: Musica-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2006; 92,409 GT; approx. 2,550 guests at double occupancy.
